meaning: Conditional organ inference of q.75 a.2 from the two existing cognitive-scope and bodily-determinacy premises and the new source-attributed organ-interference premise. Three omission controls exhibit an organ when any premise is removed; the organ-interference control also retains non-bodyhood and the old interference premise. The controls test formal-schema entailment, not metaphysical possibility or a whole physicalist theory. No root premise is discharged.
